item.title: Dunkin’ Donuts to open location at Mill Run near Hilliard
item.description: COLUMBUS, Ohio (WCMH) – A Dunkin’ Donuts location is coming to Mill Run. The coffee and donut chain will open at 3635 Data Point Court, according to city permits. item.title: Former STRS member appeals ruling, argues he did not breach his duty
item.description: COLUMBUS, Ohio (WCMH) -- A former member of the state teacher's pension board is appealing a court ruling that said he and another member acted outside the best interest of teachers.
